ff_rime.name: Fair Rime
ff_rime.desc: White crust from the Frostfair, harder than salt. The Builder and the forge use it.

ff_fair_token.name: Fair Token
ff_fair_token.desc: A brass token stamped ADMIT ONE. Sells well to collectors.

ff_cider.name: Hot Cider
ff_cider.desc: Hot cider with a clove stuck in every cup. Restores 80 health, keeps healing you for a few turns in battle, and calms you (Dread -20).

ff_fairlight.name: Fairlight
ff_fairlight.desc: A fair-candle in a paper lantern. It remembers every festival. Refills your lantern by 30, restores 20 health and calms you (Dread -40).

ff_wardens_key.name: Warden's Key
ff_wardens_key.desc: A brass key stamped FAIRWARDEN. It opens the Warden's Booth, north of Lantern Row.

ff_cellar_key.name: Cellar Key
ff_cellar_key.desc: A key on a string that has been round a neck for fifty years. It opens the trapdoor in the bank of the Skating Pond.

ff_receipt.name: Receipt: the Fair at Wintering
ff_receipt.desc: Received of the Fair at Wintering, the flame of the Great Lantern, in trust until the first thaw. The Lamp-Master swore to hold the Fair until it came home. Marit Ostrand wrote my name in the book of lenders herself. She has a steadier hand than mine. -A.

ff_given_flame.name: Marit's Coal
ff_given_flame.desc: A coal the size of a thumbnail in a glass no bigger. It is warm in a way the lantern is not. It was given.

ff_wintering_flame.name: Wintering Flame
ff_wintering_flame.desc: The coal left in the Great Lantern's base. Cold fire has gone out of it; it is only warm.

ff_greatcoat.name: Fairwarden's Greatcoat
ff_greatcoat.desc: The Fairwarden's greatcoat, lined with fifty winters' wool.

ff_lamp_pole.name: Lamp-Lighter's Pole
ff_lamp_pole.desc: A lamp-lighter's long pole, brass-hooked, worn smooth where a hundred hands have held it.
